plan: I have a value of $30. Since this is the first and only round, I need to maximize my profit in this single instance. The optimal strategy in a first-price sealed-bid auction with N bidders (here N=3) is to bid (N-1)/N * Value. However, this is a second-price auction (highest bid wins, but pays second highest). In a second-price auction, the dominant strategy is to bid your true value. This guarantees you win if your value is higher than others and you pay no more than your value.
